title: Not indestructible
text: I bought the Super Chewer monthly box for my 10 pound Eskimo that is very destructive with her toys. Bark Box advertised that their toys for this particular subscription were indestructible, but they were not. My Eski would destroy them within minutes. When I contacted Bark Box about getting indestructible chews, they were unable to send me any of that description. They refused to cancel my subscription and I was forced to stop the paypal payment to be able to stop the subscription. I wasn't willing to continue paying for chews that were inappropriate for my pet.
label: negative
